_: What runs on a request, in this order, and nothing else. Editing this file
is how you change what a session is.
The default is deliberately not 'everything in stages/'. A module is
harmless to have loaded and its default is on; a stage rewrites the
conversation, and one that started running because it happened to be
checked out would be a change to every session that nobody made. So a stage
on disk and not in this list is available, listed by `bottleneck kernel
identity is in this list rather than built into the wrapper, and deleting
the line turns it off. That is the whole test of whether this is an
interface: nothing here is privileged, including ours.
BOTTLENECK_KERNEL_STAGES overrides the list for one process - a
comma-separated order, or 'none' to forward every request exactly as it
came, which is the first thing to try when a session is behaving oddly.
